sections.title: A family company *since the 1990s*
body: Aiken Systems Unlimited is a family-operated security company that has served Aiken since the mid-1990s.
It has been accredited by the Better Business Bureau since 2007, with an A+ rating, and customers mention a monthly monitoring price that is easy on the budget.

items.q: Do you monitor the systems you install?
items.a: Yes. Customers pay a monthly monitoring fee. Call for today's price.

items.q: Can you add cameras to my alarm?
items.a: Camera systems are one of the company's services. Call (803) 641-7300 to talk it through.
303 Silver Bluff Road in Aiken. Some directories still list an older Marlboro Street address.

sections.title: Time to protect what's yours?
sections.text: Call the office on Silver Bluff Road.

before: No website of its own: a search turns up the BBB and directory pages
Directories give two different street addresses
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the company controls
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for system packages, monitoring plans and a quote request as the company supplies them
